name: Ember Dart
notes: Always available on the Bolt button. Within 1.6 m the Bolt button does a staff strike instead (stamina 12; interrupts casts).

name: Cinder Step
notes: Mobility without stamina. Trail ticks dedup per tick id and target.

name: Kindle
notes: The tension builder: buys Heat without contact. Rooted during the cast.

name: Brand Lance
notes: Pierces shields and Scutum walls. The line is drawn to the target during the cast.

name: Ring of Cinders
shape: ring around self r 3 m + knockback 2 m

name: Pyre Circle
shape: ground circle r 3 m at a point
notes: Positional area: a telegraph ring fills for 0.8 s before it lands.

name: Furnace Heart
notes: Absorb drain is doubled while it lasts. The hothead's gamble.

name: Sunfall
notes: Caster is rooted for the 0.8 s cast and can be interrupted by a staff strike. The shadow grows for 1.2 s.

name: Brand Wrath
notes: Each tick has its own activation id. A perfect absorb can only catch the first tick.
